name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Browse tab (added in 0.0.119) now shows an actual cover-art grid instead of a plain text list, matching the look of the Catalog tab - a new Browse/{serverId}/Image endpoint proxies each item's cover art through this server (a short-lived per-item token for a Jellyfin peer's own Peer/Images route; a server-side fetch-and-relay for a Plex source's own credential-bearing image URL, which must never reach the browser directly) so the grid can show real posters without exposing either kind of remote credential client-side.
